english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something will happen soon.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zau6 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 laa3

english.note: Use 就 before a location or target to mean exactly there or directly beside it.

examples.english: I'll wait right at the entrance for you.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zau6 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5
